# Sefik Ilkin Serengil

> A technical blog and portfolio showcasing expertise in machine learning, cryptography, system design, and AI applications through tutorials, publications, and professional services.

Sefik Ilkin Serengil is an MSc Computer Science graduate and fintech developer specializing in AI/ML, cryptography, and homomorphic encryption. The site features peer-reviewed publications, online courses, conference talks, and in-depth technical tutorials covering everything from facial recognition to event-driven architecture.

## Key Topics

- Machine Learning
- Cryptography
- Vector Embeddings
- Facial Recognition
- Python
- FastAPI
- Event-Driven Architecture
- System Design
- Digital Signatures
- DeepFace
- Homomorphic Encryption
- Deep Learning
- Neo4j
- Kafka
- API Design

## Machine Learning & AI

- [Introducing Brand New Face Recognition in DeepFace](https://sefiks.com/2026/01/01/introducing-brand-new-face-recognition-in-deepface): DeepFace face recognition: directory search to scalable ANN databases
- [What Are Vector Embeddings? And Why They Matter in AI](https://sefiks.com/2025/06/28/what-are-vector-embeddings-and-why-they-matter-in-ai): Explanation of vector embeddings and their applications in AI/ML
- [How to Calculate Percentage-Based Confidence Scores from Similarities of Embedding Models](https://sefiks.com/2025/09/02/from-embeddings-to-confidence-scores-converting-similarity-to-percentages): Converting embedding similarity to confidence scores with logistic regression

## Backend Architecture & System Design

- [A Gentle Introduction to Event Driven Architecture in Python, Flask and Kafka](https://sefiks.com/2025/09/04/a-gentle-introduction-to-event-driven-architecture-in-python-flask-and-kafka): Introduction to event-driven architecture with Python, Flask, and Kafka
- [Building an Atomic, High-Throughput Election System: A System Design Case Study](https://sefiks.com/2025/09/15/building-an-atomic-high-throughput-election-system-a-system-design-case-study): System design case study: real-time election tracker with Redis and PostgreSQL
